metadata.name: perf-messages-scroll
metadata.description: Perf-capture flow (intent:performance). Assertion-free. Traces scrolling the Messages view, which the operator reports as laggy: per-scroll-event virtualizer work, row measurement, and re-renders of the mounted window. Scrolls up through history in stepped frames, then back down. Ensures the Messages view first and restores the view mode it found. Runs against the live workspace (no routed test pool): scrolling a real transcript can advance that session's read cursor. NEVER bind as a requirement automation case.

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const deadline = Date.now() + 90000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const toggle = document.querySelector('[data-testid="workspace-toggle-view"]'); const pane = document.querySelector('[data-testid="terminal-pane"]'); if (toggle && pane) { window.__perfInitialViewMode = toggle.getAttribute('data-view-mode') || 'terminal'; return window.__perfInitialViewMode; } const retry = document.querySelector('[data-testid="health-retry-button"]'); if (retry instanceof HTMLButtonElement && !retry.disabled) retry.click(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250)); } throw new Error('perf-messages-scroll: workspace with a view toggle did not appear'); })()

metadata.label: Wait for the workspace and record the current view mode

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const toggle = () => document.querySelector('[data-testid="workspace-toggle-view"]'); const mode = () => toggle()?.getAttribute('data-view-mode') || 'terminal'; if (mode() !== 'messages') { const button = toggle(); if (button instanceof HTMLElement) button.click(); } const deadline = Date.now() + 25000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const scroller = document.querySelector('[data-testid="messages-scroll"]'); if (scroller && document.querySelector('[data-event-id]')) { await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2500)); return { rows: document.querySelectorAll('[data-event-id]').length }; } await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); } throw new Error('perf-messages-scroll: messages view did not render rows'); })()

metadata.label: Ensure the Messages view is showing and settled

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid="messages-scroll"]'); if (!el) throw new Error('perf-messages-scroll: scroller not found'); const frame = () => new Promise((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve())); const fire = () => el.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', { bubbles: true, deltaY: -120 })); let steps = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 90 && el.scrollTop > 0; i++) { fire(); el.scrollTop = Math.max(0, el.scrollTop - 360); await frame(); steps++; } return { steps: steps, scrollTop: el.scrollTop }; })()

metadata.label: Scroll up through history, one step per frame

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid="messages-scroll"]'); if (!el) throw new Error('perf-messages-scroll: scroller not found'); const frame = () => new Promise((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve())); let steps = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) { const atEnd = el.scrollTop + el.clientHeight >= el.scrollHeight - 2; if (atEnd) break; el.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', { bubbles: true, deltaY: 120 })); el.scrollTop = el.scrollTop + 360; await frame(); steps++; } await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1500)); return { steps: steps }; })()

metadata.label: Scroll back down to the end

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const want = window.__perfInitialViewMode || 'terminal'; const toggle = () => document.querySelector('[data-testid="workspace-toggle-view"]'); const mode = () => toggle()?.getAttribute('data-view-mode') || 'terminal'; if (mode() === want) return 'already-restored'; const button = toggle(); if (button instanceof HTMLElement) button.click(); const deadline = Date.now() + 15000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { if (mode() === want) return 'restored'; await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); } throw new Error('perf-messages-scroll: could not restore the original view mode'); })()

metadata.label: Restore the view mode this flow found
